title: Charta Visa Travel Authorization Data
subtitle: Who needs which travel authorization, what it costs, and U.S. visa wait times
description:
Open data on travel authorizations (ESTA, UK ETA, ETIAS, Canada eTA, US B1/B2 visa): which nationality needs which product, the government fee in its own currency, validity, processing, the official government source for every row, the 2026 'Cost of Crossing Borders' report tables, and a monthly time series of U.S. visitor-visa interview wait times as published by the U.S. Department of State.

Charta Visa is an independent private service, not a government website. Government fees are stated separately and paid to the authorities in full.

Source and always-current version: https://chartavisa.com/research · https://github.com/jorgegonzalez97/chartavisa-open-data

resources.description: Tables behind 'The Cost of Crossing Borders 2026': per-authorization fees, validity, fee history and eligible-nationality counts, then per-nationality authorization burden and total government fees (USD).
One row per (nationality, destination) pair: product, government fee + currency, service availability, processing, validity, official government source.
JSON envelope of the same rows as visa-requirements.csv, with column list and vintage.
U.S. visitor-visa wait times by consular post, State Department vintage 2026-07-28.
Manifest of the U.S. visitor-visa wait-time snapshots (one file per State Department vintage).
